purpose: Registered (PREDICTIONS_FRESH.md, commit c81f086). FRESH-1 and FRESH-2 for the six registered arms: each arm is retrained on its registered config with seeds 11/22/33 in one job (shared TRAIN trajectory, per-seed dreams and recognition, VALIDATION reported), and its final checkpoint runs fresh1 and fresh2. At scoring time each arm's TRAIN trajectory and VALIDATION records are compared with rsi3/results_*/<ARM>_seed*.json; a mismatch is reported, not repaired.
